title: Project Management, Coordination & Ethics
objective: To establish a robust project management framework, secure all necessary ethical approvals, finalize the study protocol, and ensure efficient coordination and communication among all consortium partners from the project's outset.

title: Dissemination & Exploitation
objective: To disseminate the project's findings to academic, policy, and public audiences, and actively promote the exploitation of the results, including the finalized implementation toolkit, and ensure comprehensive open science data management via a standalone technical report.

tasks.title: Stakeholder Engagement, Toolkit Finalization & Public Consultation
Core Data Management & Knowledge Transfer Planning

title: Platform & JITAI
objective: To develop, test, and deploy the functional digital platform, including the Just-in-Time Adaptive Intervention (JITAI) engine, verification logic, and data pipelines necessary for delivering the intervention.

title: Integrated Field Operations
objective: To formally establish the partner ecosystem, recruit the pilot cohort, and execute the 6-month active intervention phase, integrating all operational components from setup to delivery.

title: Data Analysis & Interpretation
objective: To perform primary analyses (feasibility metrics and preliminary effectiveness), causal mediation (COM-B), moderation analyses (exposome), and produce the statistical analysis report.
